title: HOW FUEL WELL IS MADE
subtitle: Two edits. One route to the PNG.

edit1.heading: CHANGE THE HEADLINE
edit1.note: Type new words between the quotes. The poster prints them in capitals and shrinks them to fit one line.

edit2.heading: SWAP THE HERO ARTWORK
edit2.note: Save your picture over this file: same name, see-through background, tall 427 × 640 shape. The file is pinned in provenance.json.

route.name: fixture.json
route.does: Holds the words and the artwork names.

route.name: render.mjs
route.does: Reads the fixture and applies any command-line edits.

route.name: nutrition.mjs
route.does: Checks the fixture, then places every word and picture.

route.name: Satori + resvg
route.does: Lays out the type and paints the pixels.

route.name: render.png
route.does: The finished poster you open and check.
